INSERT INTO users (display_name, email, username, password_hash, role, access_level, company_name, phone, phone_extension, shipping_name, shipping_address, billing_address, shipping_same_as_billing, assigned_promo_code, assigned_discount_percent, approval_status, approval_decided_at, approval_decided_by_user_id, is_active, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

SELECT users.id, users.display_name, users.email, users.username, users.password_hash, users.role, users.access_level, users.company_name, users.phone, users.phone_extension, users.shipping_name, users.shipping_address, users.billing_address, users.shipping_same_as_billing, users.assigned_promo_code, users.assigned_discount_percent, users.approval_status, users.approval_decided_at, users.approval_decided_by_user_id, users.is_active, users.created_at 
FROM users 
WHERE users.role = ? AND users.is_active IS 1 AND (lower(users.username) = ? OR lower(users.email) = ?)

SELECT users.id AS users_id, users.display_name AS users_display_name, users.email AS users_email, users.username AS users_username, users.password_hash AS users_password_hash, users.role AS users_role, users.access_level AS users_access_level, users.company_name AS users_company_name, users.phone AS users_phone, users.phone_extension AS users_phone_extension, users.shipping_name AS users_shipping_name, users.shipping_address AS users_shipping_address, users.billing_address AS users_billing_address, users.shipping_same_as_billing AS users_shipping_same_as_billing, users.assigned_promo_code AS users_assigned_promo_code, users.assigned_discount_percent AS users_assigned_discount_percent, users.approval_status AS users_approval_status, users.approval_decided_at AS users_approval_decided_at, users.approval_decided_by_user_id AS users_approval_decided_by_user_id, users.is_active AS users_is_active, users.created_at AS users_created_at 
FROM users 
WHERE users.id = ?

SELECT users.id AS users_id, users.display_name AS users_display_name, users.email AS users_email, users.username AS users_username, users.password_hash AS users_password_hash, users.role AS users_role, users.access_level AS users_access_level, users.company_name AS users_company_name, users.phone AS users_phone, users.phone_extension AS users_phone_extension, users.shipping_name AS users_shipping_name, users.shipping_address AS users_shipping_address, users.billing_address AS users_billing_address, users.shipping_same_as_billing AS users_shipping_same_as_billing, users.assigned_promo_code AS users_assigned_promo_code, users.assigned_discount_percent AS users_assigned_discount_percent, users.approval_status AS users_approval_status, users.approval_decided_at AS users_approval_decided_at, users.approval_decided_by_user_id AS users_approval_decided_by_user_id, users.is_active AS users_is_active, users.created_at AS users_created_at 
FROM users 
WHERE users.id = ?

SELECT users.id, users.display_name, users.email, users.username, users.password_hash, users.role, users.access_level, users.company_name, users.phone, users.phone_extension, users.shipping_name, users.shipping_address, users.billing_address, users.shipping_same_as_billing, users.assigned_promo_code, users.assigned_discount_percent, users.approval_status, users.approval_decided_at, users.approval_decided_by_user_id, users.is_active, users.created_at 
FROM users 
WHERE users.role IN (?, ?) AND users.is_active IS 0 AND users.approval_decided_at IS NULL ORDER BY users.created_at DESC

SELECT count(quotes.id) AS count_1 
FROM quotes 
WHERE quotes.created_by_user_id = ? AND quotes.created_at >= ?

SELECT quotes.id, quotes.quote_number, quotes.status, quotes.customer_name, quotes.customer_address, quotes.customer_contact, quotes.customer_reference, quotes.comments, quotes.special_instructions, quotes.order_form_snapshot, quotes.pricing_version, quotes.revision, quotes.quantity, quotes.discount, quotes.model_code, quotes.cylinder_inputs_snapshot, quotes.price_breakdown_snapshot, quotes.created_by_user_id, quotes.created_at, quotes.edited_by_user_id, quotes.edited_at, quotes.emailed_by_user_id, quotes.emailed_at, quotes.approved_by_user_id, quotes.approved_at, quotes.assigned_employee_user_id, quotes.assigned_at, quotes.customer_update_pending 
FROM quotes 
WHERE quotes.created_by_user_id = ? AND quotes.status = ? AND quotes.approved_at IS NOT NULL AND quotes.approved_at >= ?

SELECT quotes.id, quotes.quote_number, quotes.status, quotes.customer_name, quotes.customer_address, quotes.customer_contact, quotes.customer_reference, quotes.comments, quotes.special_instructions, quotes.order_form_snapshot, quotes.pricing_version, quotes.revision, quotes.quantity, quotes.discount, quotes.model_code, quotes.cylinder_inputs_snapshot, quotes.price_breakdown_snapshot, quotes.created_by_user_id, quotes.created_at, quotes.edited_by_user_id, quotes.edited_at, quotes.emailed_by_user_id, quotes.emailed_at, quotes.approved_by_user_id, quotes.approved_at, quotes.assigned_employee_user_id, quotes.assigned_at, quotes.customer_update_pending 
FROM quotes 
WHERE quotes.status = ? AND (quotes.assigned_employee_user_id IS NULL OR quotes.assigned_employee_user_id = ?) ORDER BY quotes.created_at ASC
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT quotes.id, quotes.quote_number, quotes.status, quotes.customer_name, quotes.customer_address, quotes.customer_contact, quotes.customer_reference, quotes.comments, quotes.special_instructions, quotes.order_form_snapshot, quotes.pricing_version, quotes.revision, quotes.quantity, quotes.discount, quotes.model_code, quotes.cylinder_inputs_snapshot, quotes.price_breakdown_snapshot, quotes.created_by_user_id, quotes.created_at, quotes.edited_by_user_id, quotes.edited_at, quotes.emailed_by_user_id, quotes.emailed_at, quotes.approved_by_user_id, quotes.approved_at, quotes.assigned_employee_user_id, quotes.assigned_at, quotes.customer_update_pending 
FROM quotes 
WHERE quotes.assigned_employee_user_id = ? AND quotes.customer_update_pending IS 1 ORDER BY quotes.edited_at DESC

SELECT users.id 
FROM users 
WHERE lower(users.display_name) LIKE lower(?)

SELECT quotes.id, quotes.quote_number, quotes.status, quotes.customer_name, quotes.customer_address, quotes.customer_contact, quotes.customer_reference, quotes.comments, quotes.special_instructions, quotes.order_form_snapshot, quotes.pricing_version, quotes.revision, quotes.quantity, quotes.discount, quotes.model_code, quotes.cylinder_inputs_snapshot, quotes.price_breakdown_snapshot, quotes.created_by_user_id, quotes.created_at, quotes.edited_by_user_id, quotes.edited_at, quotes.emailed_by_user_id, quotes.emailed_at, quotes.approved_by_user_id, quotes.approved_at, quotes.assigned_employee_user_id, quotes.assigned_at, quotes.customer_update_pending 
FROM quotes 
WHERE lower(quotes.quote_number) LIKE lower(?) OR lower(quotes.model_code) LIKE lower(?) OR lower(quotes.customer_name) LIKE lower(?) OR lower(quotes.customer_address) LIKE lower(?) OR lower(quotes.status) LIKE lower(?) OR quotes.created_by_user_id IN (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT 1) WHERE 1!=1) OR lower(json_extract(quotes.order_form_snapshot, ?)) LIKE lower(?) ORDER BY quotes.created_at DESC
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

SELECT customers.id, customers.name, customers.address, customers.city_state_zip, customers.phone, customers.email, customers.created_at, customers.updated_at 
FROM customers 
WHERE lower(customers.name) LIKE lower(?) OR lower(customers.address) LIKE lower(?) OR lower(customers.city_state_zip) LIKE lower(?) OR lower(customers.phone) LIKE lower(?) OR lower(customers.email) LIKE lower(?) ORDER BY customers.name
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

children.name: check_password_hash
children.comment:
Securely check that the given stored password hash, previously generated using
:func:`generate_password_hash`, matches the given password.

Methods may be deprecated and removed if they are no longer considered secure. To
migrate old hashes, you may generate a new hash when checking an old hash, or you
may contact users with a link to reset their password.

:param pwhash: The hashed password.
:param password: The plaintext password.

.. versionchanged:: 2.3
    All plain hashes are deprecated and will not be supported in Werkzeug 3.0.
